name: Toast
summary: A brief, polite status message at the bottom-centre of the screen — 'Done: Email Priya · Undo' — that never steals focus, dismisses itself after 6 s (paused while hovered or focused) and is replaced, not stacked, when a new one arrives. Not for errors that need a response (Alert, Dialog) and not for anything the user must not miss.

pattern.name: WAI-ARIA status message (4.1.3) in a polite live region; the region itself is a landmark so assistive tech can jump to it

isOpen.intent: Controlled. The app or pattern owns the single toast; showing a new message while open replaces the content and restarts the timer — there is never more than one.

onClose.intent: Fires when the toast should go away: the timer ran out, the user pressed Escape or the close button, or the action was taken. The owner sets isOpen=false.

children.intent: The message. One short sentence; it is read once by a screen reader and vanishes in 6 s, so no detail that matters only here.

action.intent: An optional single action — Undo. Rendered as a tertiary Button inside the toast. The same outcome must be reachable elsewhere (e.g. the done row can be un-done from the list), because a toast can be missed.

timeout.intent: Milliseconds before auto-dismiss. Minimum 5000 (docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md); 0 means persistent, allowed only with an action and a visible close button. Pauses while hovered or focused and restarts on leave.

announceKey.intent: Change it to re-announce the same text twice (a live region only speaks when its content changes): 'Done.' then 'Done.' needs a new key.

regionLabel.intent: Accessible name of the landmark region that holds the toast. Localise it.

keyboard.key: Landmark navigation (screen reader) / F6 if the app binds it
keyboard.action: Moves to the Notifications region. The toast never takes focus on its own (it is a status, not a dialog); the app may bind F6 or Ctrl+Alt+T to focus the region and must document it.
Reaches the action (Undo) and the close button, in that order. Leaving the region resumes the timer.
Activates the focused action or close button.

keyboard.key: Escape (while focus is inside the toast)
keyboard.action: Dismisses. A global Escape does nothing — Dialog and quick-add own that key elsewhere.

a11y.name: The region is named by regionLabel ('Notifications'). The toast itself has no name; its content is the message.
a11y.announcements: The message element is role="status" (aria-live="polite", aria-atomic="true"), so it is read after the current utterance, once, without moving focus. Replacing the content announces the new message; the same text twice needs a new announceKey. The action button is announced by its label ('Undo').
a11y.targetSize: The toast is not a target. Its action and close buttons are Buttons (md, 40 px) and meet 2.5.8 on their own.

rules: One toast, ever. A new message replaces the current one and restarts the timer; there is no stack and no queue. Two things worth saying at once means one of them is not a toast.
Never steal focus. Showing a toast moves nothing; the user keeps typing. Focus reaches it only by landmark navigation, F6 (if the app binds it) or Tab when the region happens to be next in order.
Timing is adjustable (2.2.1): auto-dismiss is 6 s, never below 5, and pauses while the pointer or focus is inside — a user who starts reading or reaching for Undo is never cut off.
A toast can be missed, so it never carries the only way to do something. Undo in the toast is a convenience; the row can be un-done from the list as well.

Never obscures focus (2.4.11): fixed bottom-centre, inset by space.inset.lg; the app shell sets scroll-padding-block-end at least the toast's height so a focused element near the bottom scrolls clear of it.

Body is Card variant='raised' (color.surface.overlay + border) with shadow.overlay — the only elevation in the system besides Popover. Dark themes drop the shadow through the token, not through component code.

Enter motion: translate 8 px up + fade over duration.normal; leave: fade. Under prefers-reduced-motion the generated token CSS zeroes durations and the transform must not exceed 4 px — the component sets no motion the tokens cannot switch off.
Escape inside the toast dismisses; the component never listens to Escape on the document — that key belongs to Dialog and quick-add.
Built on React Aria hooks (useHover, useFocusWithin) and the system Button, not on UNSTABLE_Toast: its alertdialog role and FIFO queue are the opposite of a polite, replacing status (ADR-028).

properties.State: default / hover / focus (paused is the same visual as hover)

examples.title: Done with Undo (ActionRow)
examples.code: <Toast isOpen={toast !== null} onClose={() => setToast(null)} action={{ label: 'Undo', onPress: undoDone }}>Done: Email Priya</Toast>
